subject: Insurance
title: The Suicide Clause
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Suicide Clause.

hook.text: Most life insurance policies won't pay for suicide within the first two years. After that, they pay in full.

buildup.text: The clause prevents someone from buying insurance with the intent to die.

discovery.text: After two years, suicide is covered like any other death.

twist.text: Research shows the suicide clause doesn't prevent suicide—it only delays payouts to grieving families.

climax.text: Insurance must balance financial protection against moral hazard.

punchline.text: Two-year exclusion, then full payout. Insurance prices even the darkest risks.

quiz.question: When does life insurance typically cover suicide?
options: After the first two years of the policy
